\begin{bankq}[id=SII04-P1-PHY-S3-Q05, source={Score-II - Test 04 (07 May 2021)}, paper=1, qno=5, type=numerical, subtopic={Young's modulus}, answer={4.90}, answer_src=key, difficulty=5, diff_parts={K1 S2 I1 C1 F1}, diff_note={concepts: Searle's experiment error with a screw gauge | steps: least count of the screw gauge pitch over divisions; diameter error; Young's modulus fractional error from length diameter and extension; maximum percentage error}]

Find the maximum percentage error is the measurement of young's modulus of the material of the wire from these data.
\end{bankq}

\begin{bankq}[id=SII28-P1-PHY-S3-Q06, source={Score-II - Test 28 (23 Mar 2024)}, paper=1, qno=6, type=numerical, subtopic={Young's modulus}, answer={25.00}, answer_src=key, difficulty=7, diff_parts={K2 S3 I1 C1 F1}, diff_note={concepts: compression of a dielectric between capacitor plates, change in capacitance | steps: force between plates Q^2/(2 eps A); stress and strain of the dielectric with Young modulus; fractional change in separation; capacitance C = K eps A/d so fractional change equals the strain; compute N}]

\begin{bankq}[id=SII29-P1-PHY-S3-Q09, source={Score-II - Test 29 (26 Mar 2024)}, paper=1, qno=9, type=single, subtopic={Stress and strain}, answer={B}, answer_src=key, difficulty=5, diff_parts={K2 S3 I0 C1 F0}, diff_note={concepts: stress and strain in a heavy rope, tension in a rotating ring | steps: P strain energy per volume from the stress at L/3 of a hanging rope; Q strain at L/3 from the lower end of the accelerated rope; R stress at L/3 of the rotating rope; S tension of the rotating ring; evaluate x in each and match}]
A steel rope (density d, length L, area of cross section A. Young's modulus Y) is subjected to operations as described in List-I. Discover the correct value of x in the expressions and match.

\textbf{List-I}

(P) The rope is hanging from a ceiling in equilibrium. The elastic potential energy per unit volume at a point L/3 from the ceiling is $\dfrac{x}{18}\dfrac{(dLg)^2}{Y}$

(Q) The rope is vertical and moves under the application of vertical force $F=\dfrac{dALg}{2}$ acting at its upper end upwards. The strain at a point at a distance $\dfrac L3$ from the lower end is $\dfrac{dLg}{xY}$

(R) The rope is rotating at angular speed $\omega_0$ in gravity free space about its one fixed end. The stress at a point $\dfrac L3$ from the fixed end is $\dfrac{x}{18}(dL^2\omega_0^2)$

(S) A circular ring is formed from the rope. This ring is made to rotate with angular speed $\omega_0$ in its own plane in gravity free space. Tension in the rope is x$\left(\dfrac{dAL^2\omega_0^2}{20\pi^2}\right)$

\textbf{List-II}\\
(1) 3\quad (2) 4\quad (3) 5\quad (4) 6\quad (5) None of these

\begin{qoptions}
\opt{A}{P $\to$ 4; Q $\to$ 2; R $\to$ 1; S $\to$ 5}
\opt{B}{P $\to$ 2; Q $\to$ 4; R $\to$ 5; S $\to$ 3}
\opt{C}{P $\to$ 1; Q $\to$ 3; R $\to$ 2; S $\to$ 4}
\opt{D}{P $\to$ 3; Q $\to$ 2; R $\to$ 4; S $\to$ 5}
\end{qoptions}
\end{bankq}
\begin{bankq}[id=SII30-P1-PHY-S2-Q10, source={Score-II - Test 30 (27 Mar 2024)}, paper=1, qno=10, type=numerical, subtopic={Young's modulus}, answer={4}, answer_src=key, difficulty=5, diff_parts={K1 S2 I1 C1 F1}, diff_note={concepts: thermal stress when a rod is heated clamped | steps: stress = Y alpha delta T; force = stress times area; evaluate}]

(Given Young's modulus of steel $=2\times10^{11}\ \mathrm{Nm^{-2}}$, coefficient of linear expansion $=10^{-5}\mathrm{K^{-1}}$)
\end{bankq}

\begin{bankq}[id=SA07-P1-PHY-S3-Q04, source={Score Advanced - Test 07 (16 Apr 2023)}, paper=1, qno=4, type=numerical, subtopic={Stress and strain}, answer={6}, answer_src=key, difficulty=5, diff_parts={K1 S2 I1 C1 F1}, diff_note={concepts: plank on two rods with thermal expansion | steps: torque balance; compression of the rods; Young's modulus relation; load distribution}]
